description: This file defines the 'Acknowledgements' interface in Java, which models a collection of acknowledgements with aggregated status and associated JSON entity. It includes static factory methods, JSON serialization details, and methods to access acknowledgements and their statuses, specific to the package related to Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: Acknowledgements.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions of JSON fields used for serializing/deserializing Acknowledgements, such as entityId, entityType, statusCode, acknowledgements, and dittoHeaders.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string of acknowledgements for a specific entity type, based on the entityType parameter.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Acknowledgements instance from a collection of acknowledgements and headers. Overloaded to accept entityId and specific status code.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty Acknowledgements instance for the given entity ID and headers.
